title: Legion of Heroes
blurb: Lightning Lad takes on a new trainer in his quest to be a hero... but what happens when he learns that in order to be a great hero, you must have a great villain?!

title: The Goon Patrol
blurb:
Goon Patrol's latest heroing-for-hire gig has brought Robotman, Elasti-Girl, and Negative Man face-to-face with a massive UFO and its strange — and rather gloopy — inhabitants. Now, as Negative Man breaches the minds and memories of these alien invaders, he finds himself digging into the Goon Patrol's past and future... and the mysterious young girl who seems to be intrinsically connected to both.

When all is revealed, the Goon Patrol may never be the same again... Award-winning writer Darcy Van Poelgeest (Little Bird) and superstar artist Niko Henrichon (Spectators) continue the Next Level adventures of the world's strangest heroes.

title: Adolescant Titans
blurb: The clock is ticking to save their missing friend as the kids take their team out of the chat rooms and onto the streets of Seattle for their first stake out and attempt to infiltrate Ascend.

title: Z-Men
blurb: While the Z-Men do battle in Philadelphia, enemies put their sights on the Z-Men's home base — the Factory, in Alaska! But the Factory is not undefended... and JOHN GREYCROW is an army unto himself!

title: Trans-Foamers
blurb: THE PRICE OF BEING PRIME! How far will Elita Prime go to win the war on Cybertronica?

title: The Amazing Spooder-Man
blurb: AFTERMATH FROM ISSUE #1000! Spooder-Man goes to battle against Ravage — and Aunt March is caught in the middle — but has Spoodey already lost the war?
